command: claude --permission-mode auto (interactive TUI, driven under a pty), prompted to dispatch a Task subagent
note: The first REAL SubagentStart/SubagentStop bytes for CC — tests/sources/claude/fixtures is hand-written (no shim stamps). Ships the PARENT transcript, because that is where the dispatch lives AND what the hooks key on; the child's own transcript (where `attributionAgent` lives) is a separate scenario for the same reason. The tool is named `Agent`, not `Task` — CC renamed it undocumented in v2.1.63 — which is why detection is semantic on `subagent_type`. Home path redacted to /Users/dev. Redacted: the recorder's own MCP server / skill inventory (tool NAMES only, no credentials) to generic placeholders — a public repo and an immutable crates.io tarball are the wrong home for one machine's tooling roster, and no decoder reads those fields. Redacted: the recorder's installed plugin roster — skill and agent names, their descriptions, and the install paths that give the names back — to `example-skill-N` / `example-plugin-N:example-agent` placeholders, collapsed to three entries because the COUNT is this machine's inventory size too. Each CLI's own bundled set is kept, told apart mechanically rather than by a name list: a `:` in a claude-code agent type means plugin-provided, copilot tags `<location>builtin</location>`, codex roots its own at `r2/` or `.codex/skills/.system/`. No decoder reads any of these fields and every conformance golden is byte-identical.
